overview: When Hollywood teeters on the brink of collapse, two struggling filmmakers have just days to create the next blockbuster. Desperate for an original idea, they make the boldest creative decision imaginable: a movie with absolutely nothing in it. As their bizarre experiment goes head-to-head with an overblown sci-fi epic from egotistical studio executive Harvey Warner, an unlikely rivalry erupts that turns the film industry upside down.
